name: High Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: High Valley's east to west orientation is rare in the northern California Coast Ranges. The valley began as an east to west fault basin, and later volcanic activity, which built the Round Mountain cinder cone, closed it in and turned its drainage south into Clear Lake.
